title: Research: multi-connector / priced-shadow 7q readout obstruction (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Answers open question 1 of [#2715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2715) in the five-source common-B mutable-source alphabet of [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898): can a multi-connector readout alphabet reach `R≤78` at `Q=7` with `X=6` after a complete dirty bill?

| Alphabet | Distinct-6 min R | One-repeat R | Tariff at X=6 | Undercuts 436? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Even-subset (#2686) | 82 | 96 | 442 | no |
| Dirty shadow (legal) | **82** | 96 | **442** | **no** |
| Dual indep. same-walk | **82** | 96 | **442** | **no** |
| Clean shadow (illegal) | **71** | 88 | **420** | yes (not legal) |

Dirty shadow collapses to even-subset by sym-diff with the snapshot index. Independent dual same-walk equals even-subset by triangle inequality (`Σ_m min_a (e[a]+e[a⊕m])` machine-checked on all covering sets; not a Σe copy). A dirt-free shadow would undercut, but inherits dirt under PR1898 and fails the dirty bill.

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2715) (including [#2687](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2687), [#2686](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2686), [#2677](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2677), [#2643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2643), [#2593](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2593)) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/multi-connector-7q-obstruction/`.
Tip: `cd4ff9427c3e35efb4de09bbf1137e7b68732ecf`.

Exact: legal dirty-shadow / dual-indep min R **82** (tariff **442**); illegal clean-shadow min R **71** (tariff **420**); no legal undercut of 436.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/multi-connector-7q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/multi-connector-7q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/multi-connector-7q-obstruction/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/multi-connector-7q-obstruction/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/multi-connector-7q-obstruction
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_MULTI_CONNECTOR_7Q_OBSTRUCTION legal_min_R=82 ... answers_cr7q_oq1 no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_MULTI_CONNECTOR_7Q covering=583296 legal_min=82 ... answers_cr7q_oq1 no_new_kappa
PASS_MULTI_CONNECTOR_7Q_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/multi-connector-7q-obstruction outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.
